_note: Which map json a REAL match loads (MatchRoot with auto_start: the menu and the lobby; M2L1, binding fix 2). A begin() without the flag (the match tests) loads MatchRoot.MAP_PATH, alesia_section, the test fixture. A missing or invalid map falls back to alesia_section. When the file user://map_select_override is present, its first line wins for real matches (a phone measurement tool).
